title: Citizen analytical chemistry: building a participatory and shared science through global data generation
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SU00052E, Perspective

Adrián Fuente-Ballesteros, Victoria Samanidou, Vânia G. Zuin Zeidler
Citizen analytical chemistry (ZAC) combines analytical science with citizen science, allowing both scientists and non-experts to collect and share chemical data using simple, low-cost, portable tools.
